mistake_reason: Tool Output Misinterpretation (FM-4.2): The Assistant misread FileSurfer’s unambiguous outputs. FileSurfer computed and reported the correct averages (Hotel: 4.6; Vacation Rental: 4.4; Resort: 4.4; B&B: 4.15) and explicitly stated Highest = Hotel. The CSV and sorted list both put Hotel at 4.6 on top. Nevertheless, at steps 18 and 20 the Assistant incorrectly mapped the 4.6 value to Vacation Rentals, apparently conflating ordering and labels between the CSV and sorted list (an index/label misalignment), and concluded the wrong top accommodation type.
